decision_for_lead: The batch door applies the byte limit and the IFC input pins but not the explicit-request admission check IFC_LIMITS.active (2 queued or running): the dispatcher already runs one IFC worker at a time, and a batch of three IFCs would otherwise leave the third unread with no automatic retry.
